digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Legal Change Management reached a clear milestone today: the tool is complete and live, while Attorney Review remains on track for October 15 with a few follow-ups still open. The rest of the carry-forward list stays focused on Amazon Connect ownership, today’s SMS result, and several overdue approvals.

items.label: Completed and launched the Legal Request Tool
items.detail: Jean confirmed in Teams that the Legal Change Management project was successfully completed, and the launch message says the new Legal Request Tool went live today for managers and above.

items.label: Confirm the Q3 Legacy Award nomination was submitted
items.detail: The deadline passed Monday. Verify the submission; if it was missed, contact the program owner immediately to ask whether a late entry is possible.

items.label: Confirm the SMS production result and release ready work
items.detail: Confirm whether the business-hours SMS fired successfully, move the NTA communication deployment forward if it passed, and keep the production-ready CoE request moving independently.

items.label: Lock the Amazon Connect build inputs and owners
items.detail: The true new-user and skills delta, queue inputs, and handoff ownership still need firm answers. Today’s email thread also shows that the timing and scope of pre-launch technical documentation are still being worked through.

items.label: Close the remaining Attorney Review follow-ups
items.detail: The October 15 launch remains on track, but the team still needs the participating-attorney list and answers on whether returning clients require another attorney review or a full new intake.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews
items.detail: All five reviews are due October 15. Reserve writing time this week and collect prior-manager input where required.

items.label: Confirm Monday’s timecards and approvals are clear
items.detail: Verify payroll approvals are complete and resolve any exceptions before the week moves further.

items.label: Decide Skye Austin’s document edit requests
items.detail: Review the four requests for the VAWA AOS, Asylum, Naturalization, and I-751 case decks, then approve or decline them together at the appropriate permission level.

items.label: Complete the overdue harassment-prevention training
items.detail: Complete the Dominican Republic EOR course or confirm with HR why it remains assigned.

items.label: Turn stalled portfolio approvals into explicit decisions
items.detail: Name the decision owner and date for each material stall, or recommend an official hold so unresolved work does not repeat week over week.

items.label: Check the Legal Request Tool notification gap
items.detail: The tool is now live, but Cristina’s report that an email update may be missing information still needs confirmation and, if needed, a Halo support ticket.

items.label: Attorney Review at Intake BD working session was canceled
items.detail: The 10:00 AM working session was explicitly canceled on the calendar.

items.label: Attorney Review remains set for an October 15 launch
items.detail: Today’s progress recap confirms that the go-live date holds, scheduling is finalized, and training preparation is moving forward.

items.label: Handle the Universal Intake revamp as a separate project
items.detail: The same-day Teams discussion separated the Universal Intake revamp from the Attorney Review overhaul rather than folding it into the existing project.

items.label: Sara is out beginning Wednesday
items.detail: Her calendar shows her out through October 12, so route leadership approvals and escalations through available coverage.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup into Thiago 1:1
items.detail: Use the back-to-back meetings to carry unresolved build ownership and documentation questions directly into a decision with Thiago.

items.label: 2:00 PM EPMO team meeting is canceled
items.detail: The cancellation opens space before the 2:30 PM Astrid and 3:30 PM Laura one-on-ones; protect part of it for follow-through on today’s decisions.
